item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00380","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C03","C19","C16"],"selected_candidate_label":"C03","confidence":0.96,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C03 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for the paired Passamaquoddy letters. Both use coordinated letters to two Cabinet secretaries: one recipient is asked to prepare or update a report, the other is simultaneously assigned a complementary study, and a copy of the counterpart letter is enclosed for information so the work can inform a common policy result. C19 is the matching companion letter and is nearly as strong, but C03 more closely parallels the child's letter to the Secretary of State because it addresses the principal reporting official while notifying him of the separate request to another Secretary. C16 has strong subject-matter continuity and directly concerns Passamaquoddy and the New England–New York interagency study, but its elaborate committee-and-survey machinery is not the child's drafting structure.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I have, therefore, asked the Secretary of the Interior to advise me on the power and natural resource aspects of the report.
